name: Bon Appétit
description: Bon Appétit is a Zgharta-based frozen food and catering business with over a decade of food-sector experience. We prepare convenient, flavorful products for home kitchens, family gatherings, celebrations and special events, with delivery available across Lebanon.

Our selection includes ready-to-cook frozen appetizers and traditional specialties sold by the dozen or kilogram, alongside cooked and ready-to-serve trays and tailored catering. We also provide live food stations for events. The frozen-food range previously offered through Matbakh Ehden has joined Bon Appétit, bringing our products together under one trusted name.
